spans.text: A breeze blows through the garden, rustling the foliage and sending petals flying. A handful land lightly on Erma's hair.
Erma moves her limbs gingerly and sits up on the ground.
The mechanical monsters that were ganging up on her have finally disappeared.
Oww...
She clambers to her feet and looks around the garden in bemusement.
You're as useless as you've always been.
Can't even hold your own against this smattering of tin cans.
What's the deal with those Dolls that you sent? Why was I in there?
I have all the data of Doctor Hume's creations, including yours.
...Mother trusts you too much!
Doctor Hume could tell who's reliable.
Where are you?
Go through the garden and down the path with hedge arches, then follow the direction that the white statues are pointing at and go through the maze.
Following the Doll's instructions, Erma finally meets her in person a little over ten minutes later.
There you are.

On the soft grassy lawn is a beautiful white picnic bench made from solid wood, on which a girl in a purple dress is sipping a cup of tea. She rings the dainty handbell on the bench with a graceful flick of her wrist.
You summoned me all the way here just to give me a beating?
I wouldn't have gone to so much trouble for such a stupid reason.
So what's this all about?
Just wanted to give your body a check-up to make sure you can handle what's to come.
Are you doing this... because Mother asked you to?
Stevens M520 puts down her teacup and finally looks Erma in the eye.
First of all, your Mother is dead.
Secondly, stop referring to Doctor Hume as "Mother". That's a distinctly human behavior.
Dolls have no use for such unnecessary sentiments.
So please also stop calling me your "sister".
Do you understand?
...I understand.
You hate Mother, and you hate me.
I don't hate him. I just don't see the point in using this form of address.
Oh, so you do hate me.
The reason I summoned you here is to gain access to the real "Summer Garden".
Then we will both get what we want.
You said I could save the Commander...
Yes, you will find the key to saving the Commander in there.
While I will find the kind of world that my heart desires.
...And what does your heart desire?
It's a secret.
...You're such a tease.
Enough chit-chat.
Natalie!
I'm here, miladies.
A calm and soothing voice speaks from within the thicket. After some rustling, a white-haired maid emerges. She walks toward Erma and 520 while cleaning her hands with a handkerchief.
Lady 9, how may I help you? Natalie is here at your service.
Erma is back.
The maid named Natalie turns to look at Erma with a happy smile.
How splendid...
Lady 0, you have finally returned to the Summer Garden.
It is an honor to see you again.
Lady 0?
That's how Natalie has always addressed you.
Natalie, you know what's going on. She's lost her memory. Again.
I understand.
Please don't be alarmed, Lady 0. I am Natalie. I have been caring for you all this time, but it doesn't matter even if you don't remember me.
Just treat me as an ordinary maid and I will do your bidding.
Save the small talk, Natalie. Let's start executing Doctor Hume's will and testament. Lead us to the Great Palace.
Yes, milady. Please follow me.
Natalie, who seems very familiar with this process, leads Erma toward the lavishly decorated mansion with great patience.
Lady 0, this is the entrance hall on the first floor. The kitchen is to the west, while the elevator and guest room are to the east.
Don't waste time on giving her a tour.
Oh, c'mon! I came all the way here, so at least show me around a bit!
What if I end up having to stay for a while?!
Don't worry, Lady 9, this won't take too long.
Lady 0, please allow me to take you to your favorite gallery.
Sure!
Ignoring Stevens M520's eye-roll, Erma skips after Natalie to the other end of the building.
Creeeak...
A cold and musty smell fills the air the moment the door is pushed open, which suggests that the room has been deserted for quite some time.
But it is obvious that everything has remained in its original position, and someone has been conscientiously preserving the room as it is.
Natalie, have you been tending to this place all the while?
Yes, Lady 0.
...It must have taken a lot of work.
It's manageable. I am a professional maid, after all.
Did I like it here?
Very much. You were the one who picked out most of these displayed items. It was also you who decided on how they're to be displayed.
I don't remember any of it.
Would you like me to talk you through the collection?
Yes, please!
Then starting with the first exhibit on the left...
Stop!
At the end of her rope, Stevens M520 slams the cabinet door that Natalie has just opened.
At this rate, we'll be here for three days and three nights. You may have that kind of patience, but I don't.
Wow! You're so mean!
Do you want your Commander to die or what?!
Head straight to the Great Palace, Natalie.
As you wish, Lady 9.
Still keeping her impeccably gracious smile, Natalie opens a bookcase and takes out a crystal globe from among the myriad of ornaments and taxidermy mounts.
A lone white stork is incarcerated within the globe, wading through the still water in a blue lake, its thoughts utterly inscrutable.
Lady 0, please activate the "Summer Garden" within your neural cloud right here.
Huh? Aren't we supposed to head for the "Great Palace"?
The "Palace" is just a designation. We need to activate the virtual Summer Garden here, then Natalie will unlock a special space known as the "Great Palace".
Rest assured, Lady 0. We are currently in a safe and secure environment.
Please take this.
Natalie offers the crystal globe to Erma.
Why are you giving it to me?
We can only enter the Summer Garden when we are in your physical presence.
The Summer Garden in its entirety, not just a labyrinth locked behind door after door.
And to do that, we need a medium. This crystal globe is the medium.
So this is why you needed me to come all the way here? Only I can grant you full access to the Summer Garden?
Yes, Lady 0.
You are the mistress of the Summer Garden.
Erma, are you ready?
I'm ready.
Erma takes the ornament from Natalie.
You loved this crystal globe a lot.
I did?
Yes.
Find a random anchor point and activate the Summer Garden.
Click.
Erma hears the sound of a lock being disengaged in her neural cloud.
A blinding white light fills her vision.
What is it?
The key... An anchor point...
...Oh right, his name...
Arthur Hume.
...It is a familiar room.
The curtains are open, and the room is awash with the afternoon sun.
A blurry figure, backlit by the sunshine, is standing by the bookcase.
...Many animals went extinct after that disaster.
All that's left behind were specimens. This is a specimen of a stork chick.
Is... is it dead?
Yes, this bird died of radiation poisoning before it was made into a specimen.
Then...
Will you die too?
All men must die. Someday in the future, I, too, shall die.
The indistinct figure reaches out to pat her head.
Every human lives but once, and their souls descend on a journey towards death.
Just like sand in an hourglass flowing from one end to another.
What about me? Will I die?
You are my daughter, my undying daughter.
As long as you live, so will I.
Hume hands Erma a gun.
Your name is also the name of this gun.
...Erma Maschinenpistole. Erma EMP.
Walk further. Further away.
50 meters... No, 100.
Erma nods obediently.
Very good... Now, we'll play this game a different way.
Now you will shoot me.
Alright.
Erma acts like she's actually playing a game.
She takes up her gun, like "Mother" once taught her.
Bang—
It is a precise shot that pierces his chest.
Ugh...
Blood gushes out of Hume's body.
I'm sorry... You're free, Erma.
Boom—
Like a massive firework, he erupts in the dark, wet alley.
Blood and gunpowder stain Erma's face.
It dyes the filthy ground red.
All that's left is her, sitting on the ground, her wide eyes staring at the darkened sky...
Natalie gently wipes away the tears streaming down Erma's face.
Lady 0, please don't be sad.
Mother died...
It was me...
I killed him...
...If he hadn't wanted to die, he wouldn't have.
Lady 9 is absolutely right.
Doctor Hume would not have let himself get killed so easily.
Especially not by you. Lady 0, he would never turn you into a murderer.
Erma takes Natalie's offered handkerchief to dry her tears, then she finally looks up and does a double take.
Natalie...?
What happened to you?
Natalie's appearance has become visibly much younger.
The Summer Garden in Frankfurt is just a replica of this place.
This is the virtual space that Doctor Hume had constructed for his creations—our real home.
So... Natalie...?
Humans can't enter this place.
This is a 25-year-old Natalie that Doctor Hume created.
You know, a string of code.
Lady 0, please let me know if you need any help. Natalie is a most capable maid.
I'm sorry, I don't remember anything at all...
Doctor Hume gave me an important mission but transferred the Summer Garden's authorizations to you.
So you must be present if we are to find whatever Doctor Hume has left behind.
What have you been up to then? Were Mother and I the only ones in the Summer Garden when you left?
I am a Doll custom-built for the military to carry out secret missions.
When I left the Summer Garden, it was only you, Doctor Hume, and Natalie. By the time I came back, none of you were there anymore.
I reactivated the Natalie here.
After that, I managed to track down the real Natalie, who had stayed in Frankfurt all this time.
Then I made contact with you and AR-18.
By then... Mother had already died...
Since he's dead, we should inherit his legacy.
Natalie, please activate the Great Palace.
Yes, miladies.
Now please allow your humble servant to unlock the most grandiose building in this world—the Great Palace!
Rumble...
Erma looks up and notices that on the distant horizon, a resplendent palace has appeared in the green woods out of nowhere, its golden roof glimmering brightly in the sunlight.

There are countless windows on each level of the palace, but one cannot see clearly into the rooms through the windows from this distance. The palace almost looks as if it's been completely filled with fog on the inside.
Please look over there. That is the Great Palace.
It's beautiful...
Oh right, I should give AR-18 a status report.
A transmission error?
Lady 0, when the Great Palace is activated, the Summer Garden automatically blocks out all signals. No contact with the outside world is possible.
Doctor Hume's legacy is in there.
What exactly is it? Do you know?
We are his creations. We should find the answer ourselves.
Stevens M520 pushes open the metal gates leading into the garden and strides into the verdant greenery.
...Inside the Great Palace, the Summer Garden.

Unlike the garden, which is in the image of natural and understated elegance, the Great Palace itself is a much more extravagant Baroque structure. The pure white walls in the great hall are covered in gilded reliefs of goddesses and ivy. All pillars are held up by more gilded sculptures of goddesses.
Looking up, the ceiling fresco depicts stories of the pantheon.
As Erma stands at the heart of this cavernous hall, she doesn't feel like she has come home. Rather, this place strikes her more as a stage.
Miladies, this is the reception hall of the Great Palace. It used to function as a ballroom as well.
Where have all the tables and chairs gone? And what's the deal with these red drapes?
I'm not entirely sure. I am not authorized to enter the palace without Lady 0.
This place has changed. Something doesn't feel right...
Because Mother's gone?
Like how the little elves started building their own world after losing their master in the fairy tales?
Whoosh!
The red drapes in the center of the hall fall to the ground, revealing a gigantic portrait.
Natalie's eyes widen in disbelief.
Huh? That's...
Who's that in the portrait?
That's Doctor Hume.
But this isn't a portrait. It's a wanted poster offering a bounty.
Huh? Bounty? For Doctor Hume?
Erma's eyes skim over the gold, jeweled picture frame, the handsome-looking man in the portrait, and fall right on the number written at the very bottom...
Offering a bounty of 10 million Sardis Gold!!!
Who hung this wanted poster here?
Her Majesty requested it himself.
Oh!
An unfamiliar girl appeared behind the Dolls without anyone noticing.
Welcome, travelers. I am Mirabelle, a knight.
Archbishop Hume is now listed as wanted, and Her Majesty the King is offering 10 million Sardis Gold as bounty for his capture.
If the reward piques your interest, you are very welcome to take the poster and try your luck. I will give you all the help I can.
Hold on, aren't you...
Aren't you 620?
My dear Lady 27, it has been a long time.
Huh? Is this knight also one of Mother's children?
Why are you here? How did you get in without Erma's authorization?
As I said, I am Mirabelle, a knight.
I have been here since Her Majesty's reign began.
Erma can see Stevens M520's grimace.
What kind of trick are you trying to pull this time?
I am searching for heroes who have the bravery to pursue and capture Archbishop Hume. I would gladly offer them my aid.
Lady 0, Lady 27 seems a little odd.
I noticed.
I don't get anything she's saying.
Are there kings, archbishops, and knights in the Summer Garden?
And what is this Archbishop Hume wanted for?
Archbishop Hume swindled a billion Sardis Gold from Her Majesty's aide through Project "Pilot Whale", which makes him a wanted criminal.
One billion Sardis Gold?!!
That's nonsense! Doctor Hume is from a high-born family! He'd never do such a thing!
The evidence is indubitable. Archbishop Hume has absconded with the money. The sooner we capture him, the sooner we can undo the damage.
Could this be one of Doctor Hume's inside jokes?

I hear that many oddball scientists have a habit of adding elements of their own personal experience and some strange fantasies into their work. Maybe he made this into a sort of game we have to clear.
Doctor Hume did have a twisted sense of humor... so you may very well be right.
So we need to follow this knight's instructions?
Hey, what's your name again? Mirabelle? So we have to complete your task for the Summer Garden to revert back to normal?
Peasant Reinette, you do not possess the access clearance for me to answer that stupid question of yours.
Reinette? What's with this hillbilly name?
Oh, your name is now displayed as Reinette!
620, what the hell have you done?!
Her Majesty has recently watched a movie called "Quatre aventures de Reinette et Mirabelle" and was incredibly moved by the profound friendship between the two young women.
So I've named you and myself after them.
Reinette raises her Stevens M520. She fully intends to blow this high-and-mighty woman to smithereens.
Easy... Easy...
Damn, never thought I'd be the one to tell someone else to calm down!
You want us to catch this so-called "Archbishop Hume"?
Yes.
What's in it for us?
You will be granted an audience with Her Majesty, during which you can make a wish.
Any wish?
Indeed.
Maybe that's how we track down Mother's legacy...
In that case, I'm taking this quest on.
Lady Erma, are you certain you would like to accept this quest and capture Archbishop Hume?
Yes.
Understood. Her Majesty will reward you for your courage.
The large portrait disappears into thin air.
But how are we supposed to find him?
That's up to you.
As the one offering the bounty, you should at least provide some basic leads.
I would naturally provide Lady Erma, the one who took on the challenge, with a lead.
Lady Erma, here is the lead—the Fox Sisterhood.
What's that?
The name of a criminal syndicate specializing in scams.
Where can I find this syndicate?
That's for you to figure out yourself.
Mirabelle raises her hand with the shark puppet. The puppet turns into a balloon and transports her away.
Miladies, this is as far as my authorizations allow me to go.
That's fine, we'll handle it from here.
Just wait by the entrance of the hall.
Yes, milady. Best of luck.
If there is anything I can do for you, please don't hesitate to let me know.
Natalie executes a perfect curtsy, then quietly backs away to the door, where she keeps watch over Erma and Reinette in silence.
What do we do now?
What else can we do? We don't have any other clues, and the Summer Garden is a complete mess.
We'll just have to conduct a blanket search.
Right.
